//: Copy this file to  migration.json  in the same folder and fill in both connection strings.
migration.json is git-ignored: it holds two passwords and must never be committed.
Source - the SQL Server database being left behind. Read only; nothing is written to it.
Target - the PostgreSQL database, created with 01-create-database.sql and otherwise EMPTY.
The migrator applies the schema itself, then loads the data, then verifies it.
This is JSON, so a backslash is written twice: .\SQLEXPRESS in this file is .\SQLEXPRESS
with one backslash when read. A single backslash is a JSON error and the migrator says so.
